content.text: {"label":"outage","explanation":"Payments volume nearly doubled at 11:45 (212 calls vs 109 forecast) and service level fell to 2.4%. Card_declined calls are running at 2.67x normal and account for almost all of the excess. This matches the open P1 incident INC-20261009-3059, opened at 11:43: debit card transactions are declining because the card authorisation gateway is failing over to its DR site. General volume is at or below forecast, absences are at normal levels, no marketing campaign is running, and handle times are not materially inflated. The cause is a confirmed card authorisation outage.","plan_name":"Card gateway outage containment for payments","rationale":"Cut demand first, then add capacity. The known-issue IVR message should stop about 20% of card_declined callers. Callbacks and chat deflection of payment_status_enquiry take load off the peak. On supply, delaying breaks and cancelling payments coaching are cheap ways to free agents now. A few cross-skilled general agents can move over while keeping general above 70%, though general was only at 78.5% in the last interval, so I kept this small. Two consecutive overtime offers cover the afternoon at about Rs 10k expected cost, within the Rs 15k budget.
